# Characters & Character Design

## Character Overview

Introduces the cast, their importance to the game, and how characters support the game's vision and design pillars. Explains the overall approach to character design.

## Character Roster

Master inventory of all characters, including IDs, names, roles, brief descriptions, and links to their individual profiles. Also tracks character status.

| ID | Name | Role | Status | Profile | Brief Description |
| -- | -- | -- | -- | -- | -- |
| CHR-001 |  | Player | not started |  | Dog, main player |

## Character Roles & Archetypes

Defines recurring character categories and their gameplay or narrative functions. An archetype describes a recognizable character pattern, while a role describes what the character does in the game.

## Character Gameplay Mechanics

Defines how characters interact with game systems, including controls, abilities, movement, AI behaviors, and gameplay rules. Shared mechanics belong here; character-specific parameters belong in individual sheets.

## Character Progression & Variations

Explains how characters change throughout the game, whether through new abilities, costumes, behaviors, difficulty, or narrative developments. Describes the progression system and identifies applicable characters.

## Character Relationships

Documents interactions, dependencies, alliances, rivalries, and other relationships affecting narrative or gameplay. Can include relationship diagrams and interaction rules.

## Character Reference Sheets

Central index linking to individual Character Design Sheets, approved designs, and relevant specifications. May include thumbnails and revision or approval status.
